name: explore
description:
Traverses the knowledge graph. Supports 4 traversal types:
- fold_ancestors: walk the fold hierarchy upward from a fold
- related_entities: find entities connected within N hops
- entities_in_fold: list all entities mentioned in a fold
- supersession_chain: follow temporal supersession links from a fact

CALL WHEN: You need to understand relationships between entities or folds, or trace how facts evolved over time.
Requires a graph connection to be configured.
Cost: ~10-50ms depending on traversal depth.

entity_id.description: Entity or event ID (required for related_entities, supersession_chain)

session_id.description: Session ID (required for fold_ancestors, related_entities, entities_in_fold)

traversal.description: The type of graph traversal to perform

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: chain
description:
Discovers the shortest path between two entities through the knowledge graph using BFS traversal. Returns the chain of intermediate entities and edge types connecting source to destination.

CALL WHEN: You need to understand HOW two concepts are related — not just whether they are, but the path of connections between them. Useful for explaining reasoning chains, tracing provenance, or finding indirect relationships.
RETURNS: Ordered list of steps (entity_id + edge_type) forming the shortest path, plus hop count and confidence score.
Cost: ~5-20ms depending on graph density.

destination.description: Entity ID to find path to

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: edge
description:
Create a typed, labeled edge between two entities.

CALL WHEN:
- Building a knowledge graph with semantic relationships
- Recording dependencies (depends_on), containment (contains), inheritance (subclass_of)
- Any time you discover a specific relationship between entities

Edge types: depends_on, contains, part_of, subclass_of, calls, implements, uses, related_to

Cost: ~5ms per edge.

edge_type.description: Relationship type (depends_on, contains, part_of, subclass_of, calls, implements, uses)

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

Current storage semantics write through `typed_edge_put`; this is treated as upsert/update-compatible where supported.
